skinfolio.subtitle: Personal collection · App + collector
skinfolio.challenge: Understand a growing collection without getting lost among skins and chromas.
skinfolio.response: I built the React and TypeScript interface and a Node.js collector that syncs my collection from the League client to Supabase.
skinfolio.pipeline: I separated CommunityDragon's public catalogue from personal collection data, so skins and artwork can stay up to date without duplicating them in the database.
skinfolio.result: A collection browsable by champion, ownership and rarity, with offers, chromas and an acquisition history.
skinfolio.summary: Syncs my collection from the League client to browse skins, chromas, offers and acquisitions.

menubox.subtitle: Team orders · App + scraper
menubox.challenge: Coordinate a weekly group order without losing anyone's choices.
menubox.response: I built the ordering flow, administration tools and a Python and Playwright scraper that extracts public menus and opening hours from 14 restaurants.
menubox.pipeline: The scraper validates each catalogue before publishing it atomically. Each person retrieves their order with a token, and the database controls who can change it.
menubox.result: The team can choose dishes, review totals and edit selections while ordering is open, with a shared summary to coordinate the order.

sanriogang.subtitle: Music website · Design and development
sanriogang.challenge: Give the group a space of their own to bring together their music, images, and memories.
sanriogang.response: A digital archive bringing together the group's songs, photographs, and fragments with a distinct identity.
sanriogang.design: A collage aesthetic built around the group's logo, with galleries, video, and navigation adapted for mobile.
sanriogang.summary: A website bringing together the band’s songs, photographs and memories.

home.introduction: I build applications, work with data and automate processes. At Bitbox / IKEA, I also build tools and development workflows with AI agents. Outside work, I make projects for my League collection, team food orders and a music archive.

experience.title: Professional experience
experience.introduction: Since 2025, I have worked on internal applications, automation and data, while laying the foundations for AI agent adoption in the department.

support.title: AI-powered support analysis
support.description: I built a tool to visualize helpdesk statistics, query the data through AI agents and automatically categorize tickets with LLMs. I designed its PostgreSQL data model, normalized to 5NF, and carried out database maintenance and management.

agents.title: Development with agents
agents.description: I designed an agent harness and an agent-assisted development workflow, laying the foundations for their adoption in the department.

data.title: Data processes at scale
data.description: I refactored critical SQL queries for generating and sending statements to hundreds of thousands of users each month.

quality.title: Quality built into development
quality.description: I introduced testing practices to prevent regressions and CI/CD with mandatory tests and formatting checks. I automated code conventions with Git Hooks and Husky.

modernization.title: Application modernization
modernization.description: I rebuilt an application with Next.js and React, updating the interface and fixing existing security vulnerabilities.

backend.title: Backend renewal
backend.description: I worked with two other developers to rewrite an application's backend and central database, reducing years of technical debt and improving maintainability.

education.title: Education
education.diploma: Higher vocational qualification in Multiplatform Application Development (DAM)
